activity_summary: The seven sharers were at the Bull, and nobody had proposed it. There was roast capon, and lamb's-wool with the apples bursting. Heminges set the book open on two leaves and would not let the purse and the three nights share one. Kemp told the button at length. Five pearls, a short candle, rosemary, and the yeomen's tapers done in spoons. Nothing was found. You said the story was a lie if it found the button. It did not. You left by four, for the two hundred yards home. Your ten shillings were still uncounted against the rest.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the lack of a summons, kept the button lost, and took the two hundred yards.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Opened the book on two leaves, refused to join them, and stopped the other sentence.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Allowed spoons, and put the company in the street at four.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Left the bowl alone, began a sentence, and stopped when told.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Claimed the inn, told the button with the spoons, and added no moral.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept Sam out of the telling, and said nobody was threatening the Admiral's.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Kept the story inside the length of the bowl, and named the distance home.

facets.activity: Heard the button story and went at four

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: If this is an agreement, it agreed itself.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: A gold button, five pearls in it, gone from a kirtle since the play began.
